objective: Fully headless, zero-GUI pipeline that ingests Sketchfab 3D archives/files, normalizes geometry/materials/collisions, converts to GTA V (.ydr/.ytyp props, .ydd skinned drawable dictionaries) via Sollumz in Blender background mode, and outputs ready-to-ensure FiveM Qbox resources. v1.1.0 adds ped_clothing, generation-aware export, apparel-pack layout, toolchain probing, hardened archive/input validation, and the external-converter exclusion policy.
hard_constraints: NEVER open Blender GUI or prompt for manual user intervention during asset processing.
ALL Blender operations MUST run via `blender --background --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python <worker_script> -- <args>` with Sollumz explicitly enabled in code each run.
NEVER silently ship broken assets. Any asset failing a validation gate MUST move to `quarantine/<job_id>/` with a `failure_report.json`.

ALL generated GTA archetype/model names MUST match regex `^[a-z0-9_]{3,48}$` and start with prefix `sf_`. Apparel streaming filenames using FiveM's `fullDlc^component` convention are an explicit exception (they are stream filenames, not archetype names).
ALL production conversion is LOCAL. No automated job may contact gtax.dev, upload source assets, or fall back to a hosted converter. Local failure = normal quarantine.
Zero third-party Python dependencies outside Blender's embedded interpreter (stdlib only in orchestrator/dashboard/harness).
Never claim an unverified capability. RSC7 magic alone does NOT prove generation validity; the uint32 at offset 4 must match the probed RSC_VERSION constant for (extension, target generation).
Never silently overwrite an existing published resource, and never leave a partially published directory (stage fully, then atomic rename).

toolchain_baseline.drift_policy: version drift -> WARN_TOOLCHAIN_VERSION_DRIFT. Missing required capability -> ERR_TOOLCHAIN_INCOMPATIBLE. Pins are never auto-upgraded.

reports: blender_version, embedded python, sollumz version/module path
format providers (CWXML_GEN8, CWXML_GEN9, NATIVE_GEN8, NATIVE_GEN9 observed)
capabilities: drawable_dictionary_export, skinned_export, drawable_helpers, cloth_export, ymt_export, embedded_bounds

external_converters.policy: reference-only; explicitly excluded from the production pipeline

entries.gtax-dev/gtav-glb-to-ydr: hosted Go CLI client, not a local engine. No dependency, no auto-upload, no API key, no fallback, output may not bypass gates. Manual human comparison use only.
entries.gtax-dev/v-drawable-to-glb: hosted reverse-conversion API client. Diagnostic-only manual use; never a validation oracle; never in production.
entries.Sollumz/Sollumz: the primary local conversion engine; pinned + probed.

external_converters.network_isolation: no automated job may contact remote conversion services. A failed local conversion quarantines normally.

sidecar_schema.asset_name: string|null (default null; derived slug if unset)
sidecar_schema.collision_mode: enum [box, convex_hull, mesh_decimated, none] (default convex_hull; ped forces none)
sidecar_schema.motion_config: object (default {}; fields incl. keep_actions, part_map list|dict values + reserved '_body' label, assembly_config {max_parts, spin_min_deg, spin_name_patterns, spin_max_travel_m, spin_tail_min_dpf, part_collision} — see MOTION_SPEC.md)
sidecar_schema.exclude_objects: list of fnmatch patterns on object names (default []; matched objects + subtrees dropped after import, all modes)
sidecar_schema.asset_type: enum [prop, ped] (default prop; never guessed from geometry)

input_contract.malformed_sidecar: invalid JSON or non-object -> quarantine ERR_MALFORMED_SIDECAR (never silent-continue on defaults)

formulaic_action: Validate EVERY member BEFORE extracting anything: reject absolute/drive-letter/parent-traversal names (ERR_ZIP_TRAVERSAL), nested archives (ERR_ZIP_NESTED_ARCHIVE), member count over cap (ERR_ZIP_TOO_MANY_FILES), total uncompressed size over cap (ERR_ZIP_TOO_LARGE). Corrupt zip -> ERR_BAD_ZIP.
Extract to ./work/<job_id>/raw/.
Search recursively for primary 3D file in priority order: .glb > .gltf > .fbx > .obj; ties/selects largest file by byte size.
Zero matching files -> ERR_NO_SUPPORTED_3D_FILE. Multiple same-priority roots -> process largest + WARN_MULTIPLE_SCENE_FILES.
override.json inside the zip merges over the external one.
Preserve source sha256 + provenance fields through to the registry/report.
Magic-byte check: .glb must start 'glTF'; .gltf must start '{'; .fbx must carry FBX magic/header; .obj must be text.
Mismatch -> ERR_MALFORMED_SOURCE:<detail>.

edge_case_rules.condition: asset_type=prop AND scene contains armatures, shape keys, NLA, or actions. NOT applied to ped.
formulaic_action: Strip all actions, NLA tracks, shape keys.
Armature-deformed meshes: bake evaluated geometry at frame 1 (convert to MESH), then delete armatures and empty bone hierarchies.
WARN_STRIPPED_ANIMATION_OR_ARMATURE.
Delete CAMERA, LIGHT, SPEAKER, GPENCIL/LINEART, LIGHT_PROBE, LATTICE.
Convert CURVE/SURFACE/FONT/META to MESH else delete.
Props: unparent meshes keep_transform, delete EMPTYs. Ped variant: keep the armature and its ancestor chain; reparent orphaned children preserving matrix_world.
Delete degenerate (zero-vert/face) meshes first.
split_multi_prop=false: join all into one prop. true: each top-level mesh -> <name>_NN, cap 25 -> ERR_TOO_MANY_SUBPROPS.
Ped path: never join; every skinned mesh stays a separate drawable model.
Sample world matrices per frame across frame_window (stride>=1, ~600 max). Mover = any sample differs from folded pose; static loose meshes merge into <name>_body (ERR_NO_STATIC_BODY if none).

part_map list value = group join into ONE rigid part (label = archetype name); dict value adds kind/spin_axis/spin_rpm. Missing or duplicated member names -> ERR_UNMAPPED_PART. Resulting parts > assembly_config.max_parts (default 12) -> ERR_TOO_MANY_PARTS.

kind resolution: explicit kind wins; else auto-spin requires ALL of (a) one-directional signed cumulative rotation >= spin_min_deg (default 300), (b) still turning at window end (tail rate >= spin_tail_min_dpf default 0.1deg/frame), (c) hub evidence: name matches spin_name_patterns OR carrier-relative travel <= spin_max_travel_m (default 0.05). Passing a+b but failing c or settling -> hinge + WARN_HIGH_ROTATION_HINGE; dict spin params imply spin; else hinge. <300deg own-origin rotations stay hinge.
part_map '_body' label pins animated members into the carrier; deployed poses are carrier-relativized via the carrier's world delta (WARN_CARRIER_MOTION_RELATIVIZED) -- no-op on static bodies.

kind=spin -> <name>_propNN, manifest carries attach_offset (hub = point on recovered axis nearest centroid), initial_rot, spin_axis, spin_rpm (derived from cumulative revs/window seconds) -- never folded/deployed_rot. Static spin part requires explicit spin_axis+spin_rpm else ERR_SPIN_AXIS_UNRESOLVED / ERR_SPIN_RPM_UNRESOLVED.
kind=hinge -> <name>_partNN, manifest carries attach_offset, deployed_offset, folded_rot, deployed_rot (YXZ_deg project convention).
Collision: _body keeps collision_mode; all other targets export part_collision (default none) -- thin blades never carry collision.

Clip playback: single-clip muted NLA auto-activates per object; multi-clip objects stay muted + WARN_AMBIGUOUS_ACTIONS; motion_config.keep_actions substrings select a clip-set (no match -> ERR_KEEP_ACTIONS_NO_MATCH).
exclude_objects (fnmatch on object names) removes matched objects + subtrees after import in every mode.

edge_case_rules.condition: Extreme scale / negative transforms / unit drift.
formulaic_action: Props: transform_apply(rotation+scale), unit heuristics (WARN_AUTO_SCALED_*), scale_multiplier + rotation_offset, normals recalc.

Ped: bake world transform into mesh verts; rigid-map the armature rest bones by the SAME matrix (the only permitted edit_bones write: head/tail + roll-compensated so rest frame = M @ old_frame); armature object transform reset to identity. Never decimate skinned meshes.
bottom_center: translate so bbox min-z sits at 0, XY centered. center: bbox center at origin. keep_origin: untouched.
Ped: same pivots, applied identically to mesh verts AND armature rest bones so skinning stays consistent.
Props: >6x cap -> ERR_POLYCOUNT_EXCEEDS_HARD_CAP; <=6x -> DECIMATE collapse to ratio + WARN_AUTO_DECIMATED.
Ped: any overage -> ERR_POLYCOUNT_EXCEEDS_HARD_CAP (decimation destroys weights; never silently applied -> recorded in report.skipped).

edge_case_rules.condition: Procedural nodes, missing UVs, packed/oversized textures.
formulaic_action: Ensure active UV layer (smart_project fallback + WARN_GENERATED_SMART_UV).
Unpack packed images to textures/, downscale >max_texture_res preserving power-of-two, convert non-png to png.
Rebuild materials into Sollumz-compatible shader nodes (diffuse/normal/spec).
Zero-texture flat-color material -> generated 16x16 solid png fallback + WARN_*.
texture_mode=ytd: build external <asset>_txd.ytd, wire arch/drawable texture_dictionary, require valid RSC7 .ytd else ERR_TEXTURE_MODE_YTD_FAILED.
none -> skip. box -> AABB mesh. convex_hull -> bmesh convex hull. mesh_decimated -> <=1500 tris + loose removed.
Embedded bounds only; verified installed capability. External .ybn is NOT claimed.
Ped: collision_mode must be none (else ERR_COLLISION_MODE_UNSUPPORTED); embedded bounds verified via .ydr.xml when mode != none else ERR_COLLISION_MODE_UNSUPPORTED:verify_failed.
Requires probed drawable_dictionary_export AND skinned_export else ERR_PED_CLOTH_EXPORT_UNSUPPORTED.
Exactly one armature: none -> ERR_PED_NO_ARMATURE; >1 -> ERR_PED_MULTI_ARMATURE.
Vertex groups must name existing bones else ERR_PED_SKELETON_MISMATCH. Zero effective weights: require_weights=true -> ERR_PED_NO_WEIGHTS; false -> WARN_PED_MESH_UNWEIGHTED.
>4 bone influences per vertex -> truncate to strongest 4 + WARN_WEIGHT_INFLUENCES_TRUNCATED.
clothing_fix.normal_push_meters displaces verts along smooth normals; shape keys removed first + WARN_SHAPE_KEYS_REMOVED_FOR_CLOTHING_FIX.
No reparent/edit_bones except: matrix_world-preserving parent of meshes to the armature (drawable-model discovery), and the EC_05 rigid rest remap.
Export = drawable dictionary: root EMPTY (DRAWABLE_DICTIONARY) -> armature (DRAWABLE) -> meshes (DRAWABLE_MODEL, LOD HIGH). Emits <name>.ydd. Never .ydr/.ytyp.
Skeleton-vs-mesh sanity on the .ydd.xml: bone rest positions must overlap exported mesh bounds else ERR_PED_TRANSFORM_MISMATCH.
clothing_fix.cloth or YLD request -> ERR_PED_CLOTH_PHYSICS_UNSUPPORTED (no verified write path).

apparel_pack=true requires valid apparel_config and (for a registerable pack) a .ymt this toolchain cannot emit -> ERR_PED_APPAREL_YMT_UNSUPPORTED before publish. The .ydd conversion itself still completes first for diagnostics.

research_step_for_coder: Probe the installed add-on every run (inspect_sollumz.py -> build/toolchain_caps.json); do NOT guess operator names or hardcode RSC versions.

required_sollumz_outputs.prop: Drawable (sollum DRAWABLE) + shared YTYP archetype (bbMin/bbMax/bsCenter/bsRadius/lodDist/hdTextureDist/flags) -> .ydr + .ytyp (+ .ytd when texture_mode=ytd).
required_sollumz_outputs.ped: Drawable dictionary: EMPTY root DRAWABLE_DICTIONARY -> armature DRAWABLE (keeps skeleton) -> mesh DRAWABLE_MODELs -> .ydd (+ .ytd optional).
required_sollumz_outputs.generation: export_assets target_versions={'GEN8'} legacy | {'GEN9'} enhanced | {'GEN8','GEN9'} both. 'both' emits gen8/ and gen9/ subtrees -> two published resources (<name>, <name>_g9).

files_to_generate.template_prop:
fx_version 'cerulean'
game 'gta5'

description 'Auto-built Sketchfab prop: <name>'

data_file 'DLC_ITYP_REQUEST' 'stream/<name>.ytyp'
files_to_generate.template_ped:
fx_version 'cerulean'
game 'gta5'

description 'Auto-built skinned drawable dictionary: <name>'
files_to_generate.template_apparel:
fx_version 'cerulean'
game 'gta5'

description 'Auto-built apparel pack: <name>'

dependency '/policy:subdir_file_mapping'

files { '<ped>_<ped>_<dlc>_shop.meta' }

data_file 'SHOP_PED_APPAREL_META_FILE' '<ped>_<ped>_<dlc>_shop.meta'
notes: lua54 is NEVER emitted (deprecated; Lua 5.4 is the default runtime).
data_file declarations only for files that exist and resolve inside the resource (manifest gate ERR_MANIFEST_UNRESOLVED).

files_to_generate.source: Sollumz export renamed to the verified FiveM subdir-mapping convention
generated; runtime_status=manifest_only_requires_consumer; rotation_order YXZ_deg is a declared project convention, not AttachEntityToEntity's native default

schema.runtime_validation: NOT_PERFORMED (unless a real FXServer staging run happened)

validation_gates_before_publish: Gate 0 (worker): ERR_EXPORT_ARTIFACT_MISSING if any expected native file absent/empty/non-RSC7.

Gate 1: EVERY emitted .ydr/.ydd/.ytd/.ytyp: exists, size floor (.ydr>1024 or >256 with ytd mode, .ytd/.ydd>1024, .ytyp>64), RSC7 magic, and rsc_version at offset 4 == probed constant for (ext, target gen). Mismatch -> ERR_GATE1_RSC_VERSION_MISMATCH.
Gate 2 (prop): .ytyp bin+xml exist/parse; every .ydr basename declared; collision declaration present iff mode!=none (else ERR_COLLISION_MODE_UNSUPPORTED:verify_failed).
Gate 2 (ped): .ydd.xml parses, root is a drawable dictionary, >=2 names (dict + >=1 drawable).
Gate 4: asset_name not registered under a different source hash.
Gate 4b: emitted archetype names must not collide with registry entries or sibling .ytyp.xml under a different source hash (ERR_GATE4_ARCHETYPE_COLLISION).
Manifest gate: every quoted resource path in fxmanifest resolves inside the resource; lua54 absent.
Lua gate: generated .lua files loadfile()-checked when a lua runtime is on PATH (WARN_LUA_SYNTAX_UNVERIFIED otherwise).
Publish: staged fully first; atomic rename per resource; registry append; work dir removed; inbox source consumed on success. Failure anywhere -> quarantine, never a partial publish.
deliverables_required_from_coder: 1. inspect_sollumz.py: probe -> build/toolchain_caps.json (versions, operators, providers, rsc_versions, capabilities, deps).
2. blender_worker.py: EC_02-EC_10 + Sollumz export (prop + ped) + generation-aware target_versions + readback.
3. orchestrator.py: sidecar validation, safe zips, toolchain recording, gates, apparel emitters, both-gen publish, registry/report.
4. test_harness.py: end-to-end regression suite incl. rigged GLB fixture.
5. dashboard.py: reason map for all codes + asset-type/generation selectors.
